name: manual_15d8d3
claim: Before continuing work on a shared feature branch across sessions, always git fetch+pull (ff-only) first, even mid-task -- do not assume the remote state matches what you last pushed.

decisions.notes: On diazMelgarejo/Claude-Desktop-LLM PR #1, a concurrent session (same identity, same day) pushed 3 more CodeRabbit-driven security fixes (IPv6-bracket loopback bypass, DNS-resolved-to-loopback trust bypass, provider-validation gap) to the same branch after my last push. Continuing to edit from stale local state would have silently dropped or conflicted with real security fixes. Caught only because I re-fetched before making further changes.
